stories.title: There are now more satellites over most towns than visible stars.
stories.summary:
A study found that, on average, 710 satellites were crossing the sky each night above UK towns, with similar satellite traffic flowing above most of Europe, the US, and other mid-latitude regions. The study isn’t peer-reviewed, so take the results with a pinch of salt, but it’s one of many examples showing how congested our skies are becoming.
